record.question: Under Section 2(l) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, "investigation" means:
options: Every inquiry conducted by a Magistrate or Court.
Every trial conducted by a Criminal Court.
All proceedings under this Sanhita for the collection of evidence conducted by a police officer or by any person (other than a Magistrate) who is authorised by a Magistrate in this behalf.
Any departmental proceeding conducted by a public servant.
